# Demo image sources

Downloaded 25 October 2026. These are illustrative stock photographs, not images of Artsy Fartsy Creative Laboratory, its premises, staff or participants. Replace them with approved client photography for a real launch.

| File | Credit / source | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `painting.jpg` | [Anna Kolosyuk on Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/three-silver-paint-brushes-on-white-textile-D5nh6mCW52c) | Colorful brushes and paint pots; 1600px wide |
| `pottery.jpg` | [Earl Wilcox on Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/person-holding-round-brown-wooden-plate-88DYIsFhuSs) | Hands shaping clay on a pottery wheel; 1000px wide |
| `studio.jpg` | [Illán Riestra Nava on Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-long-table-covered-with-lots-of-paint-and-brushes-vRKpmLZdGmw) | Art workshop materials on a long table; 1000px wide |
| `kids.jpg` | [Jonathan Borba on Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/children-painting-on-canvas-at-a-wooden-table-h_eCT1D5goI) | Child painting a canvas at a wooden table; 1000px wide |

All four linked photographer pages identify these photographs as free to use under the [Unsplash License](https://unsplash.com/license).

All files are local JPEGs downloaded with `fit=crop`, JPEG format and quality 85. No remote hotlink is required to display the site. All four local files were visually inspected after downloading.
